title: 第1009章 通天青梧第1008章 四大世家藏经阁
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
方正转身向后看去，只见身后不知何时站着一名看似二十出头的年轻人。
“这位兄台认识我？”
方正心中一凝。
此人毫无征兆的出现在他身后，他却没有半点察觉，实力绝对远胜于他。
看似年轻，说不定真实年龄已经上百岁了。
思索间，那名年轻人解释道：
“我叫叶澜，叶家藏经阁的管理者，老祖察觉到你已经抵达叶家，所以特意送我前来，好接你前往藏经阁。”
嗯？
我已经抵达叶家了？
方正微微一愣，看了一眼四周。
他现在不是在一座城池里面吗，总不能这座城池就是叶家所在吧？
似乎是看出了方正的疑惑，于是叶澜解释道：
“叶家在圣地之内发展许久，族人众多，所以家族所占面积自然也大一些。
现在我们所在的地方是叶家的城池，城池之内划分为三十六坊。
路上所见之人，绝大部分也都是叶家族人，不过这都是一些旁系。
类似的城池，一共有十座。
从这里出发，一路向前，跨越十万里，接连穿过十座城池，就可以进入叶家嫡系所在的区域。
而此次我们将要前往的藏经阁就在那里。”
方正听着叶澜的解释，顿时面露震惊！
按照叶澜的说法，光是叶家旁系族人就已经占据了十万里。

那作为叶家嫡系所在的区域，恐怕占地面积更广。
这叶家的族人到底有多少，居然能占据这么大的面积？！
这还仅仅是一个叶家，其余三大世家所占面积估计不比叶家小，甚至可能更大！
“方正兄弟，走吧。”
叶澜的声音将方正从思绪当中拉回现实。
带着方正往城池中心走去。
“叶前辈，这里距离藏经阁那么遥远，我们是要通过传送阵前往？”
方正一边走一边问道。
“方正兄弟叫我叶澜即可，或者叫我叶兄也行。”
叶澜耐心解释：“叶家占地面积极大，所以每座城池之间都布有大型传送阵，可以来返于每一座城池之间。
这其中也包括了叶家嫡系所在的区域。”
“等下我们通过传送阵抵达叶家嫡系所在的区域即可。”
content_en:
Fang Zheng turned around and looked back, only to see a young man who seemed to be in his early twenties standing behind him.
"Does this brother know me?"
Fang Zheng's heart condensed.
This person appeared behind him without warning, but he didn't notice it at all. His strength was definitely far superior to him.
He looks young, but his real age may be hundreds of years old.
While thinking, the young man explained:
"My name is Ye Lan, the manager of the Ye Family Scripture Collection Pavilion. My ancestor noticed that you have arrived at the Ye Family, so he sent me here specially to take you to the Scripture Collection Pavilion."
Huh?
Have I arrived at Ye's house?
Fang Zheng was slightly startled and glanced around.
Isn't he in a city now? This city can't be where the Ye family is, right?
Seemingly seeing Fang Zheng's doubts, Ye Lan explained:
"The Ye family has been developing in the Holy Land for a long time and has a large number of people, so the area occupied by the family is naturally larger.
The place where we are now is the Ye family's city, and the city is divided into thirty-six squares.
Most of the people I saw on the road were also members of the Ye family, but these were all collaterals.
There are ten similar cities in total.
Starting from here, go all the way forward, spanning a hundred thousand miles, passing through ten cities in succession, and then you can enter the area where the direct descendants of the Ye family are located.
And the Tibetan Scripture Pavilion we are going to this time is right there. "
Fang Zheng suddenly looked shocked when he heard Ye Lan's explanation!
According to Ye Lan, the Ye family's descendants alone have occupied a hundred thousand miles.
The area where the direct descendants of the Ye family are located probably covers an even wider area.
How many members of the Ye family are there that can actually occupy such a large area? !
This is just the Ye family. The area occupied by the other three major families is estimated to be no smaller than the Ye family, and may even be larger!
"Brother Fangzheng, let's go."
Ye Lan's voice brought Fang Zheng out of his thoughts and back to reality.
He led Fang Zheng towards the center of the city.
"Senior Ye, this place is so far away from the Scripture Collection Pavilion, do we have to go there through the teleportation array?"
Fang Zheng asked as he walked.
"Brother Fangzheng can just call me Ye Lan, or you can call me Brother Ye."
Ye Lan explained patiently: "The Ye family occupies a large area, so there are large teleportation arrays between each city, so you can go back and forth between each city.
This also includes the area where the direct descendants of the Ye family are located. "
"We can wait until we reach the area where the direct descendants of the Ye family are located through the teleportation array."
